description: How the yichen-jianying-edit Skill shell is paired with a Jianying Headless checkout on Windows.

skill.name: yichen-jianying-edit
skill.license: Personal study and non-commercial use; commercial use requires the author's written permission.

windows.note: Pins include platform_support.py, runtime_profiles.py and native_fonts.py; all 16 match a Windows checkout.

macos.note: The upstream Skill pins a macOS runtime profile and a different 13-component set, so it is not a Windows substitute.

install_steps: Clone the windows-support branch and set core.autocrlf=false, otherwise every sha256 pin fails.
Copy the whole skills/yichen-jianying-edit directory into the host Skill directory; copying SKILL.md alone is not enough.
Export JIANYING_HEADLESS_ROOT to the absolute checkout path when the Skill lives outside the repository.
Run the doctor command and require status=ok before any native operation.
